reason: I already get a steady flow from word of mouth and Instagram, and I take most bookings myself on WhatsApp and DMs. Paying 10% of jobs I would probably get anyway, to a platform I have never seen work, is not something I would commit to in a normal week, although the free sign-up means I would at least look at it.
objection: How do I know real customers will come and how many jobs per month? Nobody has told me a number, and I cannot plan around a promise.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a real monthly count of paid, completed jobs from sellers in Riyadh or Cairo who do what I do, plus a few real requests shown to me before I have to commit anything.
